title: Color
description: A named colour with a user-assigned meaning, forming the palette used to visually classify objects (e.g. green = Backup/Veeam, blue = main LAN, red = DMZ). Songbird ships a predefined palette (examples/valid/objects/palette.yaml (shipped palette)) whose entries users may annotate via 'meaning' or extend with new Color objects. Other objects reference a Color by name in metadata.color; the reference is checked by the validator. Colors live in their own namespace.

metadata.description: Color metadata must not itself carry a 'color'.

meaning.description: What objects of this colour have in common, shown as a legend in the UI (e.g. 'Backup / Veeam'). Optional for predefined colours that the user has not yet annotated.

predefined.description: True for entries of the shipped palette. Predefined colours may be annotated (meaning) but their 'hex' is fixed; the validator rejects changes to it so the palette stays recognisable across installations.
